course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Automated tests, upgrades and rollback
goal: Prepare an upgrade with automated tests, measured evidence and verified recovery.

prerequisites.text: onec.p11; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.

sections.title: What a finished submission contains
paragraphs: Creating an archive is only one step. Another person must be able to identify the delivered source, the platform version used, the observed results and the procedure for restoring the accepted state. Retain source, platform version, a test table and a separate DT backup. A prepared candidate and a published release are different states.

The control set contains 12 of your own requests with durations 30, 45, 15, 0, 60, 20, 25, 35, 40, 50, 55 and 65 minutes. Their total is 440 minutes. Odd positions belong to customer A and total 225; even positions belong to customer B and total 215. Here “12/440” means 12 documents and 440 minutes, not division. Record actual numbers and references; they may differ from the reference labels F1–F12.

sections.title: Source versus restored copy
paragraphs: Compare references and fields before totals. Reopening checks persisted results; rereading the source separately checks that accepted work was not overwritten.

code.source:
Source: 12 documents, 440 minutes
Restored copy before editing: same documents and fields, 440 minutes
Copy after 65 → 80: 455 minutes
Source reread after the experiment: still 440 minutes
code.output: Only the experiment copy gains 15 minutes.

tables.caption: Step-by-step reasoning
rows: References and fields match the control table.

sections.title: How to check preservation
paragraphs: Compare document membership first: numbers, references, customer, service, date, status, comment and duration. Then add the durations independently. A total alone is insufficient: losing one 30-minute request and adding another 30-minute request preserves the total while changing the document set.

Create a table with check, expected result, observed result and status columns. Include separate cases for valid input, invalid-input rejection, reopening and restoration. Mark PASS only after observing the outcome. Use NOT RUN with a reason for an unperformed step. A syntax check does not replace execution.

sections.title: How to test restoration and a change
paragraphs: Close Enterprise before dumping the DT. Restore the file into a new empty infobase at a different path and verify all 12 documents and their fields. This tests whether the backup is usable. Merely having a DT file does not prove that its contents can be restored and opened.

Only in the restored copy, change the final duration from 65 to 80 minutes: the total should become 455. Close and reopen Enterprise and verify 455 again. Open the source infobase separately and verify it still contains 440. For a request whose saved duration is 30, try 1441: the existing validation should refuse it and leave the saved 30 unchanged. Keep these experiments out of the accepted source infobase.

sections.title: Equal totals with different documents
paragraphs: Document identity is independent of arithmetic. The table reveals the missing original reference and the extra new reference.

sections.title: How to deliver and return to an accepted state
paragraphs: Describe the package version, source SHA, actual platform version, test results and limitations. The SHA links the record to exact source. Preserve the cause of a failed attempt and the subsequent regression result instead of rewriting an earlier record.

A full CF load can replace a customized configuration. Test normal updates through comparison and merging in a separate copy first. Restore an accepted state into another directory and retain the failed copy for investigation. Returning old source does not guarantee reversal of changed data; identify the saved state to which recovery was actually verified.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: Success is inferred from an unavailable environment. Separate actual observations from a planned advanced scenario and name edition limits.
A failed attempt is removed to make the record look successful. Retain the original failure, its cause, correction and regression evidence.
An own-copy change is applied over the accepted original. Verify the actual directory and preserve source identities before making changes.

practice.title: Automated tests, upgrades and rollback
practice.task: Prepare delivery and recovery instructions; explain equal totals with changed references while preserving the original.
practice.environment: Separate own synthetic infobase; retain the prior module and its backup. Studio and Sandbox optional.

steps.title: Preserve and identify the starting state
steps.where: Accepted Enterprise infobase → Designer → DT dump
steps.action: In your accepted infobase list the 12 document numbers, references and fields. Add durations independently: expect 440 minutes, with 225 and 215 for customers A and B. Close Enterprise and use Designer → Administration → Dump infobase (Администрирование → Выгрузить информационную базу). Save the DT and source separately.
steps.why: Protect prior work and define the actual experiment.
steps.expected: The 12 actual documents, fields and independent totals are listed; DT and source are saved separately.
steps.troubleshooting: If older work also exists, reconcile your 12 references separately; do not delete other documents to force a total.
steps.before: Own accepted infobase and its path identified.

steps.title: Prepare the exact mechanism
steps.where: New empty infobase Designer → DT load → Enterprise
steps.action: Create a new empty teaching infobase at a different path. In its Designer choose Administration → Load infobase (Администрирование → Загрузить информационную базу) and select the saved DT. Open Enterprise after restoration and compare all 12 documents against the table, including references and fields as well as the total.
steps.why: Match implementation to its intended boundary.
steps.expected: The other infobase restores the earlier documents, references and fields with a 440-minute total.
steps.troubleshooting: Verify the actual new path; equal launcher labels do not prove independent infobases.
steps.before: The 12 actual documents, fields and independent totals are listed; DT and source are saved separately.

steps.title: Run only the available admitted route
steps.where: Enterprise in the experiment copy; source opened separately
steps.action: In the restored copy change the final duration from 65 to 80, save, close and reopen Enterprise: expect 455 minutes. Open the source separately: expect 440. In the experiment copy try saving 1441 on a request previously holding 30; observe refusal and reread the saved 30.
steps.why: Obtain an observable result in the stated environment.
steps.expected: Reopening retains 455 in the copy and 440 in the source; rejection of 1441 retains the earlier 30.
steps.troubleshooting: If 1441 persists, record FAIL and investigate validation. Do not change the expected result to 1441.
steps.before: The other infobase restores the earlier documents, references and fields with a 440-minute total.

steps.title: Check rejection and preserve evidence
steps.where: Own delivery directory and test table
steps.action: Prepare the delivery directory: source, its SHA, platform version, expected/observed table and restoration instructions. Mark each case PASS, FAIL or NOT RUN according to observation. Explain why equal totals with different references fail preservation. Retain both the source infobase and the experiment copy.
steps.why: Distinguish an incorrect conclusion and retain recovery.
steps.expected: The package identifies exact source and enables another reviewer to repeat checks and restoration.
steps.troubleshooting: Use NOT RUN and a reason for unperformed cases. A total-only screenshot does not prove document preservation.
steps.before: Reopening retains 455 in the copy and 440 in the source; rejection of 1441 retains the earlier 30.

criteria: Reconcile all 12 documents and their fields independently of the 440-minute total.

Exact own source and version; actual keys, observations and expected versus actual table.
Original and changed-copy results, failed attempts and untested environment limits.

Thought experiment: one 30-minute request is replaced by another 30-minute request with a new reference. The total remains 440. Identify which reconciliation detects the replacement; do not delete source records to manufacture this example.
